title: Al-Wadud: The Divine Name for Love, and the Two Verses That Carry It
excerpt: Al-Wadud appears twice in the Quran. Both times it arrives attached to forgiveness — once in Shu’ayb’s last appeal to Madyan, once four verses after believers are burned alive in Surah Al-Buruj.
seo_title: Al-Wadud: The Divine Name for Love in the Quran
seo_description: Al-Wadud, the Loving, appears twice in the Quran: Hud 11:90 and Al-Buruj 85:14. Both times it stands directly downstream of forgiveness. What the name means.
